display_name: Florence VR Walk: From Duomo to David X2
display_long_description:
Immerse yourself in a relaxing almost 2-hour VR experience exploring Florence like a true tourist, all from the comfort of your own home. Your journey begins at the impressive Duomo di Santa Maria del Fiore, where you’ll be mesmerized by its stunning architecture and the iconic bell tower. From here, stroll over to Piazza del Duomo, where you can admire the surrounding historical buildings, taking in the grandeur of this historic square.

Next, make your way to Piazza della Signoria, the heart of Florence. Here, you’ll be surrounded by the monumental Palazzo Vecchio and the iconic Loggia dei Lanzi, where you can take a moment to relax and observe the lively atmosphere of the square. Take in the lively art and culture while enjoying the timeless charm of this central spot in Florence. Afterward, continue along Via dei Calzaiuoli, heading toward the Arno River, passing the famous Uffizi Gallery, home to Renaissance masterpieces.

Next, cross the legendary Ponte Vecchio, enjoying breathtaking views of the Arno and the surrounding architecture. After exploring the river, retrace your steps back toward the Duomo, experiencing Florence from a fresh perspective. Your journey concludes with a visit to Michelangelo’s David at the Museo Nazionale del Bargello, where you can admire the iconic statue up close from every angle. Enjoy the city’s beauty at your own pace, discovering details that many tourists miss, all while staying comfortably at home.
